say:3:1510922001:0.text: General, hang in there! I—I'll figure out a way to get you off the front lines!
say:3:1510922001:0.source_cn: 统帅，您坚持住……我、我这就想办法带您离开前线！

say:4:1510922002:0.text: No. Don't waste time on me. Just retreat, all of you!
say:4:1510922002:0.source_cn: 不，不要管我……你们快撤退！

say:9:1510922009:0.text: I'll hold the rear... keep the Wildborn from catching up. Just—*cough*—get them to safety...
say:9:1510922009:0.source_cn: 我留下来牵制那些想要追击的雅库伯尔人，请你，咳，带他们...
say:9:1510922009:0.male: I'll hold the rear... keep the Wildborn from catching up. Just—*cough*—get them to safety...
say:9:1510922009:0.female: I'll hold the rear... keep the Wildborn from catching up. Just—*cough*—get them to safety...

choice_prompt:10:1510922009.source_cn: 我留下来牵制那些想要追击的雅库伯尔人，请你，咳，带他们撤离……
choice_prompt:10:1510922009.male: I'll hold the rear... keep the Wildborn from catching up. Just—*cough*—get them to safety...
choice_prompt:10:1510922009.female: I'll hold the rear... keep the Wildborn from catching up. Just—*cough*—get them to safety...

say:11:1510922010:0.text: I'm their general. Victory or death—there's no third path.
say:11:1510922010:0.source_cn: 我是出征的统帅……只有战死，没有战败。
say:11:1510922010:0.male: I'm their general. Victory or death—there's no third path.
say:11:1510922010:0.female: I'm their general. Victory or death—there's no third path.

say:12:1510922011:1.text: These soldiers entrusted me with their lives. That means seeing this through.
say:12:1510922011:1.source_cn: 这么多士兵……他们把性命交到我手里，不是为了保住我的命……！
say:12:1510922011:1.male: These soldiers entrusted me with their lives. That means seeing this through.
say:12:1510922011:1.female: These soldiers entrusted me with their lives. That means seeing this through.

say:13:1510922012:1.text: Go. Now! Every second we waste means more blood spilled!
say:13:1510922012:1.source_cn: 走……快走！再耽误下去，谁都保不住！走——！
say:13:1510922012:1.male: Go. Now! Every second we waste means more blood spilled!
say:13:1510922012:1.female: Go. Now! Every second we waste means more blood spilled!

choice_prompt:14:1510922012.text: Go. Now! Every second we waste means more blood spilled!
choice_prompt:14:1510922012.source_cn: 走……快走！再耽误下去，谁都保不住！走——！
choice_prompt:14:1510922012.male: Go. Now! Every second we waste means more blood spilled!
choice_prompt:14:1510922012.female: Go. Now! Every second we waste means more blood spilled!

say:15:1510922013:0.text: Thank you... for everything you've done for the Halians.
say:15:1510922013:0.source_cn: 多谢你……为呼临人做的一切。
say:15:1510922013:0.male: Thank you... for everything you've done for the Halians.
say:15:1510922013:0.female: Thank you... for everything you've done for the Halians.

say:16:1510922014:0.text: And for earlier... I was wrong. I'm sorry.
say:16:1510922014:0.male: And for earlier... I was wrong. I'm sorry.
say:16:1510922014:0.female: And for earlier... I was wrong. I'm sorry.

say:17:1510922015:0.text: <style="highlight">Take them and go.</style> Their lives... are in your hands now.
say:17:1510922015:0.male: <style="highlight">Take them and go.</style> Their lives... are in your hands now.
say:17:1510922015:0.female: <style="highlight">Take them and go.</style> Their lives... are in your hands now.

choice:14:1:2.text: I promise I'll get them out.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 放心，我会让他们安全撤离
choice:14:1:2.male: I promise I'll get them out.
choice:14:1:2.female: I promise I'll get them out.

choice:10:1:2.text: You're barely standing. Don't be stupid!
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 你受了很重的伤，别硬撑！
choice:10:1:2.male: You're barely standing. Don't be stupid!
choice:10:1:2.female: You're barely standing. Don't be stupid!

choice:6:0:1.text: Don't worry, that's why I came.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 别担心，我就是为此而来
choice:6:0:1.male: Don't worry, that's why I came.
choice:6:0:1.female: Don't worry, that's why I came.

say:20:1510922005:0.text: You—you scoundrel! If you don't want to help, at least drop the act!
say:20:1510922005:0.source_cn: 你——你这家伙！不想帮就不帮，装什么好心？！
say:20:1510922005:0.male: You—you scoundrel! If you don't want to help, at least drop the act!
say:20:1510922005:0.female: You—you scoundrel! If you don't want to help, at least drop the act!

say:21:1510922006:0.text: General, don't lower yourself! We'll get you out together!
say:21:1510922006:0.male: General, don't lower yourself! We'll get you out together!
say:21:1510922006:0.female: General, don't lower yourself! We'll get you out together!

say:22:1510922007:0.text: Stop! You're hurt too, don't be reckless.
say:22:1510922007:0.source_cn: 别逞强了！你自己也伤得不轻！

say:24:1510922008:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please... I'm trusting you with their lives.
say:24:1510922008:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please... I'm trusting you with their lives.
say:24:1510922008:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please... I'm trusting you with their lives.
